title: mymind extension
description: A big centred two-line serif headline and a short slate paragraph over a wide product picture with a thin tangerine top edge, ringed by four soft-coloured category pills that sit half on and half off it, then a disc-and-capitals play link that warms to tangerine on hover.
notes: the picture is a media slot; the pills are built (labels and colours as props)
name: mymind-extension

props.name: title
props.description: headline lines (each starts a new line on desktop)

props.name: media
props.description: the product picture; empty shows a placeholder

props.name: pills
props.description: up to four category pills floating over the picture

props.name: link
props.description: the play link under the picture
